defects.claim: The issue requires sub-agent rows rendered "from a fixture event stream". The test instead writes `CHAT_STORE_MESSAGES` straight into `chat.messages` (spec:42). That skips both `toChatEvent` (httpAdapter.ts:925-928) and the poll mapping (chat.ts:329-333), so the test proves nothing about the assumed event contract. Closing the Operator panel while on the Research page stops the Research page's poll loop, so the report never arrives. ChatWindow runs `onUnmounted(() => chat.stopPolling())` with no condition, and ChatView only calls `startPolling` on mount (ChatView.vue:75).

After a reload or a poll with no local user bubble, `run` covers the whole rolling conversation. User bubbles exist only locally (chat.ts:222-225), so the sub-agent tree and the Context totals add up every past run, not "the current run".
The dashboard composer sits inside `v-else class="hidden … md:grid"` (line 273), so it is missing whenever the dashboard load fails and on mobile.
The composer uses the opacity dialect `placeholder:text-ds-text/60`, and ChatView.vue repeats `text-ds-text/60`, where CLAUDE.md prefers token muted text.
